title: Bubble sort
summary: Repeatedly swap neighbours that are out of order; the largest item bubbles to the end of each pass.

title: Selection sort
summary: Find the smallest remaining item and swap it into the next position of the sorted prefix.

title: Insertion sort
summary: Grow a sorted prefix by sliding each new item left until it sits in the right place.

title: Merge sort
summary: Split the list in halves, sort each half, then merge the two sorted halves into one.

title: Binary search
summary: In a sorted list, halve the search range each step by comparing the middle item with the target.
inputLabel: Sorted numbers, smallest first (2 to 16, separated by commas)

title: Two pointers (pair with a given sum)
summary: In a sorted list, move a left and a right pointer towards each other until two items add up to the target.
inputLabel: Sorted numbers, smallest first (2 to 16, separated by commas)

title: Sliding window (largest sum of k in a row)
summary: Slide a fixed-size window along the list, updating the sum by adding one item and dropping one.

title: Valid parentheses (stack)
summary: Push every opening bracket; each closing bracket must match the one on top of the stack.

title: Breadth-first search
summary: Explore a graph level by level with a queue, starting from one node.

title: Fibonacci with dynamic programming
summary: Fill a table bottom-up so each value is computed once from the two before it.
